demos.name: P1 Third-Party Exchange
demos.description: PingOne token exchange (RFC 8693) that accepts a third-party signed JWT (PingFederate, another PingOne environment, Okta, Auth0, RFC 9068, Microsoft) as the actor token: trusted issuer, assignment, claim mapping, the checks and PingOne's measured refusal texts. Mock only.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5200). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials, no outbound network. Docker: HOST_PORT=5200 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Catalog id D98 confirmed by the owner 2026-10-27. The capability is feature-flagged and the guide gives no flag name. A third-party SUBJECT token is not simulated. The hosted Mock card is the SE build (MODE=mock, hosted simulation); the real mockUrl is set only in the shelf's local file, never in this repo (placeholder host here).
